stem.text: An oil drop has mass $m$ and charge $q$. The drop is held stationary in an electric field between two parallel horizontal plates, distance $d$ apart, as shown.

stem.alt: Oil drop held between two horizontal parallel plates, a cell marked V connected across them by wires, and a distance d marked between the plates; the oil drop label points to the drop between the plates

stem.text: The potential difference between the plates is $V$ and the acceleration of free fall is $g$.
What is the charge-to-mass ratio $\dfrac{q}{m}$ of the oil drop?
